changes.title: Stump fx
items: The soundsystem spell at a great stump no longer has the pink-purple glow over the stump: the analyser bars, the sigil and the soundsystem rising are the whole effect (?stumpfx=old brings the glow back, to compare)

changes.title: Legend route home
items: A friendly legend with nothing to fight now walks the whole of tonight's route to its far end, turns round and walks back, then stays to guard the home area alongside the island's own home legend

changes.title: Decks ring full
items: The ring of bars round the decks at the party start is now a full circle: its bars carry on past the edge of the Terrace instead of stopping at it
The soundsystem spell's ring of bars at a great stump is even north and south: the bass now plays at both, so the north bars are no longer the short ones

changes.title: Conga mesh
items: Her line of babies is spaced by how long each one is now drawn, so they no longer walk through each other: long ones like otters, hares and tigers keep further apart

changes.title: Dance stones
items: The stones round the dancefloor are low, rounded boulders now, about knee height and no two alike, so they no longer look like the speakers they turn into

changes.title: Wild babies
items: Wild babies now run clear of a fight, as your own babies do, and come back when it's over

changes.title: Long lunge
items: Creatures' lunges are much longer: they wind up from about a dash and a half away, then lunge about two dashes, straight through and past where you were. Dash sideways out of the line.

changes.title: Butterfly id
items: The swallowtail butterfly is its own animal in the game's files now, no longer filed under the moth's name: nothing about it changes, and islands you found or won as the moth's are still yours
The moth is a moth again, furry with feathery feelers and dusky wings, waiting on the bench: it has no island yet

changes.title: Legend back
items: Sleeping legends now lie at the back of their circles, leaving room at the front to stand before them; the circles are a little bigger to make space
Standing at the middle of a legend circle, you are now in view in front of the sleeping legend: the elephant, mole and bear included
